_note: Draft of src/data/wildlife-catalog/rules.json (spec 4.3), v3.3.3. Only the status-related keys are filled here; the other keys are as printed in the spec. v3.3: iucnCategoryNames RU / PL / LV filled from Bob (2026-10-08); 'NatureServe' added to latinAllowlist (proper name rendered in RU status text, 2.11). v3.3.1: otherStatusValues (NatureServe GX..GNA + T template; US ESA E/T/PE/PT/C/XE/XN/SAE/SAT/D3A with LE/LT aliases) merged from Bob's IUCN labels file; otherStatus values render through this map in RU/PL/LV (no raw codes, C17).

iucnCategoryNames._note: Card forms (singular, gender-safe) supplied by Bob 2026-10-08 (/workspace/nature-catalog-iucn-labels-2026-10-08.json). sourceUrl = primary source of the locale; nameSources overrides it per code where the name comes from elsewhere; officialNames = the form as the source writes it (detail pages, glossaries); needsNativeReview lists codes whose card form is not verbatim in any source (checker: WARN, not FAIL). EN = official IUCN Red List category names (v3.1). RU: gender-free phrase or explicit noun 'вид'; PL: masculine singular agreeing with 'gatunek' (as the pl.wikipedia taxobox); LV: feminine singular agreeing with 'suga' (as the Latvian Red Book).

officialNames.NT: Находящиеся в состоянии, близком к угрожаемому

ru.note: Official IUCN Russian translation (v3.1, 2001), linked from iucnredlist.org other translations; card forms are singular adaptations of the official plural names. NE card form follows ru.wikipedia ("Угроза для которых не оценивалась").

pl.note: IUCN has no official Polish translation. CR..LC: IOP PAN national Red List 2022 (Chrońmy Przyrodę Ojczystą 78/2/2022). EX "wymarły" verbatim in the pl.wikipedia taxobox template, EW "wymarłe na wolności" (pl.wikipedia Czerwona księga gatunków zagrożonych), DD "brak danych" and NE "nie oszacowano" (pl.wikipedia Status ochronny). Do not use "nieoceniony" (means invaluable).

lv.note: IUCN has no official Latvian translation. CR..LC: Latvian Red Book, 3rd edition 2025 (University of Latvia Institute of Biology, Nature Conservation Agency). DD "Trūkst datu" is the Red Book card label. The Red Book has no EX, EW or NE: these come from lv.wikipedia only ("izmiris", "izmiris savvaļā", "nav novērtēts") and were put in the feminine to agree with "suga" (Izmirusi, Izmirusi savvaļā, Nav novērtēta): native check needed.

otherStatusValues._note: Value names for otherStatus, rendered after the system intro (labels.systems.*.intro), never in the IUCN pill. Each entry: en/ru/pl/lv card text, source per language, needsNativeReview = languages whose text is a proposal or adaptation without a verbatim source. ru/pl 'wiki' sources are Wikipedia, not official texts. No Latvian native speaker has checked any LV text. US ESA keys follow US FWS ECOS codes; aliases map the NatureServe-style codes used in the spec (LE, LT) onto them. The source quotes are verbatim, so the ECOS ones contain ' -- '; these quotes are documentation, not card copy.

numberFormat._note: v3.3.3. Display unit and decimals come from the value in metres, not from the size group. One caption may mix units (e.g. '67 cm, 1.2 m'). Rounding is half-up. After rounding, promote to the next unit when the rounded figure reaches the next threshold (promoteAfterRounding: 0.996 m -> 100 cm -> 1.0 m; 9.96 mm -> 1 cm). If a millimetre figure would round to 0 at 0 decimals, use 1 decimal mm; if still 0 (< 0.05 mm), use 2 decimals mm; if still 0, C6 fails. Nothing may display as 0.
numberFormat.zeroGuard: if the chosen unit is mm and half-up rounding at decimals.mm (0) yields 0 for a positive value, retry with mmFallback (1 decimal); if still 0 (below 0.05 mm), retry with mmFallbackMax (2 decimals); if still 0, C6 fails; nothing may display as 0

proboscideanBodyLength._note: v3.3.3 (Boss Bot approved 2026-10-08). SizeValue basis / caption measure for proboscideans. RU/PL/LV wording pending native review. Do not add registry methodLabels; lengthLabel here is the single source for caption spelling (C6).
proboscideanBodyLength.appliesTo: proboscideans (woolly mammoth; African savanna elephant live Surviving card pending Boss Bot decision)
proboscideanBodyLength.basis: body length without the trunk and tusks
proboscideanBodyLength.definition: straight-line body length from the rear of the rump (tail base) to the front of the forehead (skeleton: rostrum to tail base); trunk and tusks excluded. Height = shoulder height (hump), trunk hanging.
proboscideanBodyLength.primarySource: Boeskorov 2021, Arctic and Subarctic Natural Resources 26(1), DOI 10.31242/2618-9712-2021-26-1-4
proboscideanBodyLength.mammothNote: Boeskorov 2021: length rostrum to tail base; skeletal shoulder-height / length index mean 0.7525 (adult East Siberian bulls, n=7); card length from height/0.7525.
